edges.text: Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod, take info: ValidationInfo and read earlier fields from info.data instead of values.
Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.
Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod, take info: ValidationInfo and read earlier fields from info.data instead of values.
Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.
Replace @root_validator with @model_validator; pre=True becomes mode='before' on a classmethod taking the raw dict, otherwise mode='after' on an instance method returning self.
Replace @root_validator with @model_validator(mode='before') on a classmethod that works on the input dict.

Remove Config.json_encoders; add @field_serializer for the affected fields (or a PlainSerializer in Annotated) that produces the same output, and move other Config keys to model_config = ConfigDict(...).
Remove json_encoders and add a @model_serializer(mode='wrap') that formats datetimes the same way.
Turn the __root__ model into a pydantic.RootModel[...] subclass and use .root instead of .__root__; parse with model_validate.
Replace the __root__ model with a TypeAdapter over the inner type plus a plain helper class.
Replace Model.update_forward_refs() with Model.model_rebuild().

Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod; pre=True becomes mode='before', each_item=True becomes validating the list items in the function, always=True becomes validate_default=True on the Field.
Move the check into an Annotated type with AfterValidator / BeforeValidator.
Replace @validate_arguments with @validate_call.
Rename removed config keys to their v2 names in model_config = ConfigDict(...) (allow_mutation=False->frozen=True, orm_mode->from_attributes, fields={...alias}->Field(alias=...)).
Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod, take info: ValidationInfo and read earlier fields from info.data instead of values.
Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.

Replace `PostCode.__get_validators__` with `__get_pydantic_core_schema__(cls, source_type, handler)` returning `core_schema.no_info_plain_validator_function(cls.validate)`. Import `core_schema` from `pydantic_core`; this keeps the existing normalization and validation while removing the deprecated hook.

Replace the `PostCode` field type in `Delivery` with `str` and add a `@field_validator("post_code", mode="before")` that applies the current `str(v).replace(" ", "").upper()` normalization, rejects values that are not exactly five digits, and returns the normalized string.
Rename removed config keys to their v2 names in model_config = ConfigDict(...) (allow_mutation=False->frozen=True, orm_mode->from_attributes, fields={...alias}->Field(alias=...)).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model.model_validate(data).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model(**data).
Replace Model.parse_raw(body) with Model.model_validate_json(body).
Replace Model.parse_raw(body) with Model.model_validate(json.loads(body)).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model.model_validate(data).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model(**data).
Replace Model.schema() with Model.model_json_schema().
Replace .copy(update=...) with .model_copy(update=...).
Replace .copy(update=...) with Model(**{**obj.model_dump(), **update}).
Replace Model.__fields__ with Model.model_fields; field.required becomes field.is_required(), outer_type_ becomes annotation.
Set model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) and replace Model.from_orm(obj) with Model.model_validate(obj).
Replace Model.construct(**data) with Model.model_construct(**data).
Replace .dict(...) with .model_dump(...), keeping the same keyword arguments.
Replace .dict() with dict(obj) and filter keys by hand.
Import Field from pydantic and declare key as `key: Union[int, str] = Field(union_mode="left_to_right")` so Pydantic tries the int branch first and parses numeric strings as integers.
Add a `@field_validator("key", mode="before")` that converts string values matching an integer representation with `int(value)` and returns all other values unchanged.
Declare `sku` with `Field(coerce_numbers_to_str=True)` and import `Field` from `pydantic`, so numeric inputs are converted to strings during validation.
Add a `@field_validator("sku", mode="before")` that converts integer inputs to `str` and returns other inputs unchanged; import `field_validator` from `pydantic`.
In `from_sensor`, pass `units=int(reading)` when constructing `StockLevel`, so fractional sensor readings are truncated before integer validation.

Add a Pydantic v2 `@field_validator("units", mode="before")` that converts float inputs with `int(value)` and returns other inputs unchanged, so fractional readings are truncated during model validation.
Replace the `parse_obj_as` import and call with `TypeAdapter` from Pydantic, then return `TypeAdapter(List[User]).validate_python(rows)` from `load_users`.
Remove the `parse_obj_as` import and return `[User.model_validate(row) for row in rows]` from `load_users`.

In changed_fields, replace the deprecated __fields_set__ access with model_fields_set: return sorted(ProfilePatch(**raw).model_fields_set).

In changed_fields, dump the parsed model with exclude_unset=True and sort the resulting keys: return sorted(ProfilePatch(**raw).model_dump(exclude_unset=True).keys()). This preserves explicitly supplied None values.

Import `field_serializer` from `pydantic` and add a `@field_serializer("price")` method to `Quote` that returns `float(price)`. This makes `model_dump_json()` emit `price` as a JSON number while retaining `Decimal` internally.

Import `Annotated` and `PlainSerializer`, then declare `price` as `Annotated[Decimal, PlainSerializer(float, return_type=float)]`. This serializes the Decimal as a JSON number while preserving its internal type.
Add a `@field_serializer("started", when_used="json")` method on `Shift` that returns `value.isoformat()`. This makes JSON-mode serialization emit `+00:00` for UTC datetimes.

In `to_wire`, dump `s.model_dump()` in Python mode and pass `default=lambda value: value.isoformat()` to `json.dumps`. This serializes `started` with `datetime.isoformat()`, which emits `+00:00` for UTC.

Change `AuditEntry.at` from `datetime` to `date` and import `date` instead of `datetime`; Pydantic will serialize the field as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

Keep `at: date`, and add a `@field_validator("at", mode="before")` that converts `datetime` values and ISO datetime strings (including strings with a time component) to their `.date()` value before date validation. Import `datetime` and `field_validator` from the appropriate modules.

Change `at` to `datetime` so timestamp strings validate, and add a `@field_serializer("at")` that returns `value.date().isoformat()` so JSON output remains date-only. Import `datetime` and `field_serializer` from the appropriate modules.
